'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**At least 42 women, residents of an [[IDP camp]], are [[kidnapping in Nigeria|abducted]] by [[Islamic extremism|Islamic extremist group]] [[Boko Haram]] in [[Jere, Nigeria|Jere]], [[Borno State]], [[Nigeria]].  [https://apnews.com/article/borno-bokoharam-kidnap-extremists-bfef61a6fa6d778433e3e7344d6dd331 (AP)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2022–2023 western Russia attacks]]
****The [[governor]] of [[Belgorod Oblast]], [[Russia]], says that a [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] attack killed three [[civilian]]s in the region. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2023/08/23/Russia-says-three-killed-in-Ukrainian-drone-attack-in-border-region-of-Belgorod- (AFP via Al Arabiya)]
***Four people are killed and four others are injured in a [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[drone strike]] on a school in [[Romny]], [[Sumy Oblast]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/two-killed-russian-attack-ukrainian-school-interior-minister-2023-08-23/ (Reuters)]
**[[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure (2022–present)|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***A Russian [[Unmanned combat aerial vehicle|drone]] strike on agricultural facilities in [[Izmail]], [[Odesa Oblast]], destroys 13,000 tons of grain and damages infrastructure. [https://edition.cnn.com/europe/live-news/russia-ukraine-war-news-08-23-23/h_5d04020c265e6936b727b050902826bf (CNN International)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Hawaii wildfires]]
**The [[Federal Bureau of Investigation]] reports that around 1,110 people have been missing since the [[wildfire]]s that affected [[Maui]], [[Hawaii]], [[United States]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-66596328.amp (BBC News)]
*[[2023 Mizoram bridge collapse]]
**Twenty-six people are killed when a [[railway bridge]] being built across a [[ravine]] collapses in [[Mizoram]], [[India]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/8/23/many-killed-in-railway-bridge-collapse-in-indias-mizoram-state (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2023 Tver Oblast plane crash]]
**An [[Embraer Legacy 600]] [[aircraft crash]]es in [[Tver Oblast|Tver Region]], Russia, killing all ten people on board. The leader of the [[Wagner Group]] [[Yevgeny Prigozhin]] and mercenary [[Dmitry Utkin]] were listed as passengers. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-66599733 (BBC News)]
*Eight people are killed and several others are injured when a bus drives off the [[Prithvi Highway]] and crashes into the [[Trishuli River]] in [[Gajuri Rural Municipality|Gajuri]], [[Nepal]]. [https://apnews.com/article/nepal-bus-accident-mountain-road-71424b0313373576fd119523fbb906ac (AP)]
*At least two people are killed and 37 more are rescued during a [[Structural integrity and failure|building collapse]] in [[Abuja]], Nigeria. [https://punchng.com/just-in-dozens-feared-killed-others-trapped-as-abuja-high-rise-building-collapses/ (Punch)]
*Two people are killed and another is injured when an aircraft operated by the [[Lebanese Air Force]] [[plane crash|crashes]] near [[Hammana]], [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/8/23/two-dead-in-lebanon-military-helicopter-crash (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2023 Atlantic hurricane season#Tropical Storm Franklin|Tropical Storm Franklin]] makes landfall on the island of [[Hispaniola]], with heavy rain reported in the [[Dominican Republic]] and [[Haiti]]. [https://apnews.com/article/tropical-storm-franklin-haiti-dominican-republic-floods-9172b46177a80fec91340478f235586d (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 Trabuco Canyon shooting]]
**Three people are killed and six others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] at a [[biker bar]] in [[Trabuco Canyon, California|Trabuco Canyon]], [[Orange County, California|Orange County]], [[California]], United States. The perpetrator is killed in a [[shootout]]. [https://apnews.com/article/california-bar-shooting-be474bdb916250261808d34cc20f67b3 (AP)]
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
**The [[United States Department of Justice|U.S. Justice Department]] announces that they have brought 718 law enforcement actions costing [[United States dollar|$]]836 million in [[COVID-19 scams|COVID-19 fraud]] during [[COVID-19 pandemic|the pandemic]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/2023/08/23/covid-aid-fraud-justice/ (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[Southwark Crown Court]] in [[London]], [[United Kingdom]], rules that two teenagers were part of the [[hacking group]] [[Lapsus$]] and participated in a [[blackmail]] campaign against technology companies, including [[Rockstar Games]], the maker of the ''[[Grand Theft Auto]]'' [[video game]] series. [https://apnews.com/article/grand-theft-auto-computer-hack-blackmail-e5ee22c1d8932f43b912dd6455f2f3c4 (AP)]
*[[Cyprus]] says it has dismantled a criminal [[human smuggling]] ring responsible for transporting [[Immigration|migrants]] on boats from Lebanon, [[Syria]] and [[Turkey]]. [https://apnews.com/article/cyprus-human-smuggling-syria-lebanon-turkey-arrests-e55ecbe91ea22ad14971f7a1560b473f (AP)]
*[[Meta Platforms|Meta]], [[Facebook]]’s parent company, and 184 of its [[content moderators]] based in [[Kenya]] agree on a [[mediation]] attempt to settle in a lawsuit seeking [[$]]1.6 billion in compensation, alleging poor working conditions, insufficient mental health support and low pay. [https://apnews.com/article/kenya-facebook-content-moderators-meta-lawsuit-sama-5dca81fa5df9aa87886366945818dfa9 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Immigration to Germany]]
**[[Cabinet of Germany|Germany]] passes legislation to ease [[German nationality law|citizenship]] rules, aiming to reduce a shortage of [[skilled worker]]s and to improve the integration of [[immigrant]]s. [https://apnews.com/article/germany-government-citizenship-rules-7638771d85a52ad30f90153cc762bda8 (AP)]
*[[War in Amhara]]
**[[Amhara region]]al president [[Yilkal Kefale]] resigns after the [[Ethiopian government]] placed the region under a [[2023 Ethiopian state of emergency|state of emergency]]. [https://www.trtafrika.com/africa/ethiopias-amhara-region-head-resigns-amid-violence-14680203 (AFP via TRT Afrika)]
*[[2023 Zimbabwean general election]]
**[[Zimbabwe]]ans vote for a [[President of Zimbabwe|president]] and members of the [[National Assembly of Zimbabwe|National Assembly]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230823-zimbabwe-to-vote-in-uphill-election-for-defiant-opposition (AFP via France 24)]
**A [[presidential decree]] extends voting by one day in 40 [[Ward (electoral subdivision)|ward]]s across the country due to delayed distribution of ballot papers, which the [[Zimbabwe Electoral Commission|electoral commission]] attributes to late printing caused by court challenges. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/zimbabweans-vote-hopes-ending-economic-freefall-appear-dim-2023-08-23/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Chandrayaan programme]]
**[[Chandrayaan-3]] makes a soft landing near the [[Lunar south pole|Moon's South Pole]], marking [[India]]'s first landing on the [[Moon]] and the first soft landing of a [[spacecraft]] near the lunar South Pole. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/08/23/world/chandrayaan-3-lunar-landing-attempt-scn/index.html (CNN)]
*[[List of North Korean missile tests|North Korean missile tests]]
**[[North Korea]] launches a [[military satellite]] from the [[Sohae Satellite Launching Station]]. The launch fails due "to an error in the emergency blasting system during the third-stage flight", according to [[Korean Central News Agency|state media]], with the satellite likely crashing into the [[Pacific Ocean]] after passing over [[Okinawa Prefecture]], [[Japan]]. [https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2023/08/101922da381d-flash-n-korea-fires-missile-on-1st-day-of-satellite-launch-window-japan.html (Kyodo News)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-66601760 (BBC News)]
